blockers.message: The legacy global-options proposal has no verified draft boundary.
The 0.1.0 research mapping cannot authorize or produce an import plan.
Attachment identities and content digests are absent from the research evidence.
No source record-value snapshot is available for a deterministic content plan.
Actual versioned ACF field keys and types are absent.
No target object, identity or revision inventory is available for comparison.
The proposed WordPress schema has not been approved or verified.
Taxonomy definitions, terms and assignments are unresolved.
